title: convert a script holding Script tags

phases.job: Your team's script, from_your_team/daily_fails.hql, writes mart.daily_fails, a table in a database you can't write to. The scheduler that runs it puts a value in place of each <PARM="NAME"/> before Hive reads it: this time it put 2026-09-24 for RUN_DAY and data for SKIP_TEAM, and the script has run, so mart.daily_fails holds its rows. Make your own copy of that table in your Dev Database, mart_dev.daily_fails, written there and checked against the original, with the Toolbox. Your Dev Database is mart_dev, and your Prod Database is team_prod. Each new table you make goes in the folder /data/team/<its database>.db/<its name>, such as /data/team/mart_dev.db/weekly; a table someone else made stays where it is.
